objective: Determine whether quantized end-to-end latency benefit can be materially improved, with matched controls and preserved navigation inputs and model weights.
candidate_families: Remove redundant single-device executor IPC using the installed native UniExecutor
Measure frontend, engine communication and worker preparation without synchronizing GPU
Investigate smaller native decode scheduling intervals without changing output policy
Widen native W4A16 launch configuration search with independent numerical validation

invariants.weights: Existing frozen checkpoints, SHA verified, no requantization
invariants.input: Identical original two-image and nine-image payloads; original mRoPE and all visual tokens retained
invariants.engine: batch/TP/DP=1, context4096, complete prefill budget3072, FP16 KV64x64, prefix cache off, native decode graph on
invariants.fixed_generation: Greedy seed7, exactly18 or64 returned tokens; report actual decode forwards separately
invariants.navigation: If tested, original author policy, temperature0.3/top_p0.95/max512/seed7/400-step limit unchanged

measurement.screening: The 1_18 cell may screen candidate viability; cannot generalize it to other loads
measurement.http_modes: Streaming and nonstreaming are separate experiments; navigation-facing conclusion requires nonstreaming confirmation
measurement.repeat: Promising configurations require an independent reversed-order or interleaved round with FP16 and old W4A16 controls; retain every run
measurement.summary: HTTP P50/P95, TTFT where streaming, vision/prefill/decode events and host timings, actual forward counts, output token IDs/hashes, sampled GPU state

decision.correctness: Same-weight execution changes must preserve input SHA and fixed-output token sequence; changed arithmetic also needs independent packed-weight numerical reference checks before full-model timing
decision.screening_gain: Seek at least5% HTTP median improvement over the same-model control without over2% P95 regression in repeated matched measurements; small/unstable differences remain inconclusive
decision.quantization_gain: Report T_FP16/T_quant using equally optimized FP16 and quantized paths, separately from new_quant versus old_quant absolute latency reduction
decision.quality: Fixed-output agreement does not prove closed-loop quality. Any navigation subset is reported separately and never merged into old100 results
decision.limitations: No inference that 10 samples prove statistical significance; no choosing a favorable slow baseline; no promise of speedup before measurement

ownership: Only the root agent runs GPU work. All experiments serialized. New isolated source and log paths; no installed-package or historical-source edits. Never read server.md.
